variants.label: A330-300
variants.configuration: 242 t weight variant with activated center tank; Trent 700. Earlier 233 t A330-300 configurations differ.

variants.label: A330-900neo
variants.configuration: 251 t weight variant. Does not claim the later 253 t / 183 t enhancement package.

sources.title: Airbus A330 flight deck and systems briefing, Issue 4
Airbus A330 training FCOM, system architecture reference
Airbus cabin pressure and outflow valves
Airbus Trent 7000 technical training, ATA 76, July 2022 (hosted copy)

coverage.architecture: Independent A330 electrical, hydraulic, fuel, pressurization and flight-control topology; three-spool engine indications; common route editor and flight-guidance practice.
coverage.estimates: Engine response/limits, fuel flow, tank allocation/transfer thresholds, cabin schedule, V-speeds, aerodynamic coefficients and flight motion are bounded local training estimates, not AFM performance tables.
coverage.pending: Tail-specific FCOM effectivity, full abnormal ECAM procedures, detailed generator load shedding, FADEC protection laws, fuel CG scheduling and autoland certification fidelity are not validated.

lessons.title: Hydraulics
lessons.text: Green has pumps on both engines and the RAT; blue has an engine 1 pump; yellow has an engine 2 pump. Each circuit has an electric pump. No PTU connects these circuits.

lessons.title: Flight controls
lessons.text: Three PRIM and two SEC computers replace the A320 ELAC/SEC/FAC organization. Available computers and hydraulic circuits affect the local flight-control law.

lessons.title: Fuel
lessons.text: Wing inner/outer, center and trim tanks are represented. Center and outer fuel transfers to inner tanks; trim fuel transfers aft in cruise and forward for descent. Crossfeed shares engine feed, not fuel between wing tanks.

lessons.title: Pressurization
lessons.text: Two outflow valves have FWD/BOTH/AFT manual selection. Automatic pressure control has two controllers. Valve position, cabin altitude and differential pressure respond to packs and leaks.

lessons.title: Trent engine variants
lessons.text: Both engines have N1, N2 and N3 spools. The Trent 700 uses EPR as its normal thrust indication; the Trent 7000 uses N1. The HP spool used for starting is N3.

lessons.title: Brakes
lessons.text: Normal brakes use green hydraulics. Alternate and parking brakes use blue hydraulics and its accumulator. There are eight main-wheel brakes.
